{
  "name": "pr-watch",
  "description": "A line above the prompt for each pull request Claude opens, merges by number, or is asked to watch, showing its GitHub workflows with a progress bar, then ready to merge, the failing job, or what blocks it, and telling Claude the same without being asked.",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "Oak OSS",
    "email": "hello@oakoss.dev",
    "url": "https://github.com/oakoss"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "repository": "https://github.com/oakoss/claude-plugins",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/oakoss/claude-plugins/tree/main/plugins/pr-watch",
  "keywords": [
    "pull-request",
    "github",
    "ci",
    "github-actions",
    "mod",
    "status"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "wake": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Wake Claude",
      "description": "What a watched pull request tells Claude unasked. Checks: ready to merge, a failed job, conflicts, requested changes, and a merge's checks. Checks and comments: also comments and reviews by people other than you. Off: only you hear it, from the line and its toasts.",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "checks",
        "checks and comments"
      ],
      "default": "checks and comments"
    },
    "botComments": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Bots wake Claude",
      "description": "Which comments and reviews from authors GitHub marks as a bot also tell Claude, when Wake Claude includes comments. Reviews: a review bot's reviews, not plan, coverage or preview comments. Comments and reviews: everything a bot posts.",
      "options": [
        "never",
        "reviews",
        "comments and reviews"
      ],
      "default": "never"
    }
  }
}
